summary: Solaris Resources Inc. filed a Form 6-K with interim financial statements and MD&A for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The report contains routine financial disclosures, including a net loss of $8.5 million, exploration expenses, and a deferred revenue liability of $141 million. No special-situation transaction or corporate event is described in the filing. This is a standard periodic reporting obligation for a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, and the exhibits consist solely of financial statements and officer certifications. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, or other transformative event disclosed in the text.
